feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Smithsonian chief Lonnie G. Bunch III resigns
entry.summary: Bunch has spent the last few months defending the Smithsonian against attacks from President Trump. In a statement, Bunch says he leaves with "mixed emotions."

entry.title: How Caroline Rose threw out the rulebook on their latest album
entry.summary: Caroline Rose's new album, Gentling the Horse at the Walt Whitman Mall, is out Oct. 23.

entry.title: Australian social media users to be offered choice to opt out of algorithms
entry.summary: A government statement said on Tuesday social media platforms would be required to send a notification to new and existing users offering them a choice over their default feed.

entry.title: U.K. accuses Israeli settlers of 'ethnic cleansing' in West Bank and bans their goods
entry.summary: France, Canada and other countries joined the U.K. in banning goods from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel said it would close the British Consulate among other measures.

entry.title: Whatever happened to the Taliban threat: 'We will flog the women'?
entry.summary: In 2024, the ruling Taliban pledged to use flogging as well as stoning to punish people for not following certain of their precepts — committing adultery, running secret schools for girls. Have they followed through?

entry.title: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
entry.summary: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now.

entry.title: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
entry.summary: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to.

entry.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people
entry.summary: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war.

entry.title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
entry.summary: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.

entry.title: 60 years later, 'Star Trek' continues to 'live long and prosper'
entry.summary: The television series 'Star Trek' turns 60 on Tuesday. The original show aired for only three seasons, but it spawned prequels and sequels (on TV and in theaters) and still has a cult following.
